symptom: React useState updates fire but DOM does not re-render in Playwright headless
root_cause: Expo static web output pre-renders HTML; React hydration does not process setState from event handlers in headless Chromium
fix: Replace all useState for form values/errors with pure DOM manipulation (getElementById reads/writes)
prevention: Never use React state for form field values or validation errors in web-only components tested with Playwright

symptom: button type=submit triggers native HTML form navigation (page reload) in Expo web
root_cause: Expo web does not prevent default form submission; e.preventDefault() fires but page still navigates
fix: Use type=button with onClick handler instead of type=submit
prevention: Always use type=button for buttons inside <form> in Expo web

symptom: react-native-paper TextInput fill() not working in Playwright; id targets wrapper div not real input
root_cause: RN-Paper TextInput renders a wrapper div and the id prop goes on the wrapper not the <input> element
fix: Use plain HTML <input> elements in web-only components
prevention: Avoid react-native-paper TextInput in web-only form components tested with Playwright
